jobs.title: Product Manager confirmé H/F - SaaS - Fintech
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme une référence sur le marché français.

N2F est une plateforme complète de Spend Management (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs, budget), conçue pour simplifier le quotidien des entreprises grâce à une expérience fluide, intuitive et 100 % connectée (web et mobile).

Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur.

Tes principales missions :

Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme.

Stratégie de Produit :

  • Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit.

  • Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients, des utilisateurs et des équipes internes.

  • Analyser les tendances du marché, la concurrence et les évolutions technologiques afin d’identifier les meilleures opportunités de développement.

  • Participer à l’identification et à l’évaluation de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’IA, à l’automatisation et aux agents.

Gestion du Cycle de Vie du Produit :

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap de ton périmètre.

  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les opportunités en fonction de leur impact utilisateur et business.

  • Superviser le cycle de vie complet des fonctionnalités, de la discovery au lancement avec le Product marketing.

  • Mesurer les résultats et ajuster les orientations en fonction des retours terrain et des données.

Développement de Produit :

  • Piloter la conception et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités avec les équipes Product Design et Engineering.

  • Garantir une expérience utilisateur simple, intuitive et performante.

  • Valider les solutions proposées grâce à des tests utilisateurs, des analyses de données et des expérimentations.

  • Veiller à délivrer des solutions pragmatiques, robustes et créatrices de valeur.

Le travail collaboratif est au cœur du rôle :

  • Travailler étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Customer Success et Support afin de comprendre les enjeux clients.

  • Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

  • Favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités produit.

  • Participer à la promotion du produit en interne et en externe.

  • Contribuer à la diffusion de la culture Produit au sein de l’entreprise.


Ce que l’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu disposes d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Manager, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu sais appréhender des problématiques métier complexes et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.

  • Tu maîtrises les méthodologies agiles et les bonnes pratiques Produit.

  • Tu es capable de piloter un sujet en autonomie et d’embarquer les équipes autour de tes projets.

  • Tu sais arbitrer, prioriser et faire des choix pragmatiques et orientés impact.

  • Tu as déjà mené des projets d’envergure impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

  • Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et tu cherches à comprendre les sujets en profondeur avant de prendre des décisions.

  • Tu disposes d’un esprit analytique fort tout en gardant une forte orientation utilisateur.

  • Une sensibilité forte à l’IA est attendue

    • Tu t’intéresses activement aux évolutions de l’intelligence artificielle et à leurs applications concrètes dans les produits SaaS.

    • Tu utilises régulièrement des outils tels que ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini ou des assistants IA similaires dans ton quotidien professionnel.

    • Tu sais identifier les opportunités où l’IA, les LLM, l’OCR ou les agents peuvent apporter une valeur tangible aux utilisateurs.

    • Tu sais distinguer les effets de mode des usages réellement créateurs de valeur.

  • Tu es bilingue Français / anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise rentable, en forte croissance et ambitieuse à l’échelle européenne.

  • Travailler sur un produit utilisé par plus d’un million d’utilisateurs à travers le monde.

  • Évoluer dans une équipe Produit structurée composée de Product Managers, Product Designers et Product Marketing Manager.

  • Contribuer à des sujets stratégiques mêlant SaaS, finance, IA et automatisation.

  • Bénéficier d’un environnement collaboratif où les idées sont écoutées et où l’impact individuel est réel.

  • Avoir la possibilité de délivrer rapidement de la valeur et de voir concrètement les résultats de son travail.

Poste ouvert en CDI et full remote.

jobs.title: AI Product Owner (Lyon, France)
jobs.description:
Location : Lyon, France

About ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team

  • An international team (with more than 38 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
  • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
  • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity, Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), MandA (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry

Requirements

Location: Lyon, France

Contract: Permanent (CDI)

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. Acting as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and the Data/AI leadership, you will ensure that AI initiatives are delivered with strategic alignment, operational rigor, and measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

1.       Product Development and Strategic Alignment

·       Collaborate on defining the product vision and roadmap for AI initiatives, in close alignment with firm priorities.

·       Translate & challenge business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories

·       Ensure AI solutions deliver measurable value and are adopted effectively across business lines

 

2.        Backlog Management

·       Own, prioritize and continuously refine the product backlog in collaboration with business & development teams

·       Ensure delivery cadence is maintained and risks are proactively escalated

3.        Business Partnering and Change Management

·       Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, gathering needs, managing expectations and driving adoption

·       Support business teams in understanding AI capabilities and in defining use cases with high ROI potential

·       Lead change management efforts to ensure smooth integration of AI tools into existing workflows

·       Manage & develop support materials

 

4.       AI Expertise and Innovation

·       Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of AI/ML trends, tools and best practices relevant to company’s needs

·       Evaluate new AI solutions and vendors, providing informed recommendations to the ISD leadership

·       Ensure responsible AI principles (explainability, fairness, data privacy …) throughout product development & usage

 

5.       Coordination and Governance

·       Coordinate cross-functional teams (Compliance, Cyber, Business) to ensure end-to-end delivery

·       Define and monitor KPIs to track product performance and adoption

·       Contribute to AI governance frameworks, documentation standards and reporting to senior stakeholders

 

 

 

Profile and Qualifications

·       Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business or a related field

·       Experience: Minimum 5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with at least one significant AI or data-driven product deployment

·       Solid understanding of AI, data pipelines and modern development methodologies  & technologies

·       Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language and vice versa

·       Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and non-technical teams

·       Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach

·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French is a plus)

·       Experience in financial services, private equity or healthcare is a plus

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/f/d) Home Energy Solution (B2C)
jobs.description:
Why The Mobility House?

  • Help shape our vision of an emission-free energy and mobility future 
  • High levelof responsibility and rapid development in a growing and innovative company
  • Open, diverse & international team
  • Flexible working hours and additional vacation days
  • In the event ofa child's illness, you are entitled to up to 15 days per year with full continued payment of wages
  • Mobile working from home and 20 days in other European countries 
  • Choice between the latest Apple and Dell IT equipment
  • Subsidy for Deutschlandticket job
  • Wellpass membership
  • Lease of your preferred car and bike via FINN or JobRad
  • Modern office with good public transport connections
  • and much more!



What you do

  • As Product Manager Home Energy Solution (B2C/B2B), you are responsible for our smart charging product and our home energy solution over the whole product lifecycle
  • You design, create, launch and operate products based on our existing and newly developed technology and the experience we gathered 
  • You talk to customers to uncover their needs and shape solutions they love
  • You define the product strategy to increase the addressable market and to potentially bringthe product to further countries
  • You ensure that all launch activities are tackled and transparently shared with partners and internally
  • You work together with home energy management partners to ensure seamless integration with a first focus on Germany
  • You work closely together with our technology, energy supply and hardware team to ensure a smooth end-to-end user experience
  • You align frequently with internal and external stakeholders and are the first contact person for eyond and our Home Energy Solutions
  • You monitor financial performance of your products and adapt roadmaps and planning accordingly
  • You are constantly monitoring the market, regulatory changes, competition and trends in the E-Mobility and Energy Sector and derive consequences for the development of our products


Who you are

  • You have at least three years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner.
  • You worked in the energy industry in the past, preferablyas product manager for a B2C energy product
  • You already gathered experience in the home energy management, energy or electric mobility sector.
  • You are excited to work in a rapidly changing environment and to create a new products from the scratch
  • You can keep the big picture in mind and manage conflicting interests accordingly.
  • You excel when working with internal and external stakeholders.
  • You are a team player, enjoy working in cross-functional teams and have a hands-on mentality.
  • You speak German & English fluently


Are you a good fit for us?

Diversity enriches our team and makes us stronger. Regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, or any disability – everyone is welcome here! We look forward to receiving your application and achieving great things together.  


Your contact -----

jobs.title: Product Manager (Evergreen - Talent Pool)
jobs.description:
This is not an active opening. We're collecting applications for future Product Manager roles.

Location: Fully Remote (preferance for candidates in Europe)

Coordination time: UK/European business hours

Team: Product Team

Employment Type: Contract

Company Description

Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-driven platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs and GPs in the private-markets secondaries space. By combining deep sector expertise with modern infrastructure, we unlock liquidity across private equity, private credit, and real assets, transforming the industry and enabling investors to move faster and smarter.

As our Product Manager, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of shaping features from concept through delivery. You’ll work at the centre of designers, engineers, and key stakeholders to make sure we’re building the right things, the right way. This role requires you to balance product thinking with effective stakeholder management to ensure we build the right solutions, aligned with both user needs and business goals.

Tasks

Requirement Gathering & Documentation

  • Engage with stakeholders to capture and refine feature requests
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured requirement documents for designers (wireframes, user stories) and tech (specs, acceptance criteria)

Backlog Management

  • Own and prioritise the product backlog, balancing user impact, technical feasibility, and business value
  • Write and maintain epics, requirement docs, and detailed acceptance criteria
  • Anticipate dependencies and flag risks early to keep execution smooth

Release Planning and Overseeing

  • Collaborate with product team/tech leads to plan upcoming releases and ensure timely delivery
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and retrospectives as part of the product team
  • Reinforce product development process across teams

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Serve as the primary liaison between design, engineering, QA, and business teams
  • Ensure all teams have clarity on what’s being built, why, and how success will be measured

Stakeholder Communication

  • Communicate progress, trade-offs, and timelines clearly to internal teams and leadership
  • Run demos, gather structured feedback, and turn insights into actionable next steps
  • Manage expectations calmly and confidently in a high-pressure environment

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Contribute to product vision, roadmap planning, and goal setting
  • Analyse usage data and user feedback to identify opportunities for iteration and optimisation based on evidence, not assumptions and drive continuous improvement

Requirements

  • 2-3 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a fast-paced or early-stage environment
  • Experience working directly with clients — gathering requirements, managing relationships, and project managing delivery
  • Strong command of Agile/Scrum practices and tools (e.g., YouTrack, Notion, Jira)
  • Ability to write clear epics, user stories, specifications, and acceptance criteria
  • Basic UX/UI understanding and ability to collaborate with designers; familiarity with Figma is a plus
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including expectation-setting and cross-functional alignment
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where systems are still being built, while also helping create the processes and structures we need as we grow.
  • Experience using analytics, user research, and experimentation tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Posthog, A/B testing) to guide decisions
  • Ability to be proactive and available in a remote working position

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (w/m/d) - Abrechnung & ERP
jobs.description:
Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Fachprozesse, übersetzt Anforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen und willst zentrale ERP- und Abrechnungsmodule in einer eigens entwickelten Softwarelösung weiterentwickeln? Dann gestalte mit uns den nächsten Entwicklungsschritt im Rahme des weiteren Teamaufbau’s als:


Senior Product Manager (w/m/d) - Abrechnung & ERP

Wir suchen eine/n Senior Product Manager/in (w/m/d) - Abrechnung & ERP für unsere Softwarelösung ginisuite, unser ERP/PVS für Arbeitsmedizin und Arbeitssicherheit. Die Rolle kann remote in Deutschland oder hybrid aus Berlin ausgeübt werden. In dieser Rolle verantwortest Du die Weiterentwicklung zentraler Fachmodule unserer ginisuite mit Fokus auf Verträge, Rechnungswesen, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Entwicklungsteam, relevanten Stakeholdern im Management und unseren Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und begleitest Themen von der fachlichen Anforderungsanalyse über die Übersetzung in User Stories und Tickets bis hin zu QA, Release, Datenmigration und Rollout.


Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Produktverantwortung für Abrechnung & ERP

    • Ownership für die Fachmodule Verträge, Rechnungswesen, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung innerhalb unserer eigens entwickelten Softwarelösung

    • Evaluierung und Weiterentwicklung operativer Prozesse und Standards mit Schwerpunkt Abrechnung und Vertragswesen

    • Identifikation fachlicher Verbesserungspotenziale und Überführung in wirksame Produktanforderungen

  • Anforderungen, Umsetzung & Rollout

    • Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen und Übersetzung in klare User Stories und Tickets sowie Begleitung der Umsetzung durch das Entwicklungsteam

    • Hands-on Unterstützung entlang des Entwicklungsprozesses, inklusive QA und Release

    • Unterstützung bei Datenmigrationen sowie Begleitung von Rollouts

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit:

    • dem Lead PM sowie dem CTO und weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern im Management

    • unseren Tochtergesellschaften zur Aufnahme fachlicher Anforderungen und operativer Bedarfe

    • dem Entwicklungsteam bei Umsetzung, Testing und Weiterentwicklung

    • internen und externen Partnern, z. B. dem Data-Warehouse-Team.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Nachweisbare Berufserfahrung im Produktmanagement, bevorzugt mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen, ERP, Abrechnung oder vergleichbaren B2B-Softwarelösungen

    • Ausgeprägte Bereitschaft, Ownership für komplexe Fachmodule zu übernehmen und den Entwicklungsprozess hands-on zu begleiten

    • Erfahrung darin, fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare User Stories, Tickets und Produktverbesserungen zu übersetzen

    • Technische Erfahrung in den Bereichen Datenmigration, Datenanalyse und Softwareentwicklung

    • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Strukturstärke und ein ausgeprägtes Ownership-Mindset

    • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen (ca. 20 %)

  • Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

    • Erfahrung in SaaS-, Plattform- oder ERP-nahen Umfeldern sowie in technisch anspruchsvollen Produktlandschaften, z. B. mit Cloud-basierten Plattformen, APIs, Integrationen und verteilten Systemen

    • Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Microservices oder containerbasierte Systemlandschaften

    • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Legacy-Systemen und Migrationen, insbesondere im Spannungsfeld zwischen Bestandssystem und neuer Produktgeneration

    • Verständnis für operative Prozesse in einem Multi-Entity-, Buy-and-Build- oder stark wachsenden Unternehmensumfeld

    • Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Occupational Health & Safety, Arbeitsmedizin oder Arbeitssicherheit oder die Bereitschaft, sich schnell in dieses Umfeld einzuarbeiten

Unsere Benefits:

  • Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit großzügigen Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“. Ein Full-Remote Setup innerhalb Deutschlands ist auch möglich.

  • Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

About the team:

Charging turns products (tariffs), energy usage and tax into the correct charges on every bill. This role owns Charging with a strong tax focus: how tax and exemptions are configured, when and where tax is applied (per-transaction versus per-bill-document) and how charge and tax data feeds finance reporting and ERP. You own the problem end to end. Clients should be able to configure their own tax rules, launch confidently in new markets and trust the data that flows into their ERP without carrying compliance risk themselves.

You will work closely with clients but also the compliance partners and lead the Charging product area as a senior individual contributor, owning the vision and roadmap and working directly with the Charging engineering team.

Primary Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Own the Charging product vision and roadmap with tax as a first-class topic. Set the long-term direction, map the dependencies and design for the different cases

  • Drive the shift to client self-service, so clients can set up products, charges, tax and exemptions without developer intervention

  • Reduce manual intervention and lower cost to serve for our clients

  • Own the tax calculation approach including third-party coordination and define the requirements for accruals, future cost estimation and cost-of-usage so the platform gives an accurate cost picture

  • Cross-Domain Integration & Alignment

  • Understand how charging, issuance, cost calculation, ledger and ERP interact and own charging and tax as a coherent part

  • Define the tax and charge reporting requirements into finance integration

  • Lead trade-off discussions across Billing, Payments and Debt and communicating decisions clearly

  • Bring problems and requirements to engineering and leave the solution space to them, engaging the right teams early without creating bottlenecks

Market Expansion & Discovery

  • Be the voice of the client for charging and tax to understand what each market requires

  • Make sure new tax configurations and markets are supported through the core, not one-off custom builds

Key Success Metrics & Outcomes:

Your success is measured by billing accuracy, the share of charging and tax changes clients can make themselves, the range of markets supported through the core and clean compliance outcomes.

Accuracy & Operational Success

  • No misbilling incidents attributable to charging or tax

  • Higher share of product, charge and tax changes made by clients without developer involvement. For clients it means they can update a tax rate or add a tax exemption themselves, without waiting for Kraken

Compliance & Coverage

  • Clean audit and regulation outcomes on charge and tax output and correct on-time tax reporting into ERP. For clients that means their finance teams close month-end without manual tax reconciliation - so that when regulation changes Kraken reflects it and clients aren't carrying that risk

  • Charging and tax are not the blocker on client upgrades

What You'll Need:

  • Highly capable individual contributor who wants to be the domain owner for charging and tax

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally in financial, billing or tax systems, owning a complex backend area end to end

  • Hands-on experience with taxation in a product or systems context: configuration, exemptions, cross-jurisdiction rules and the difference between transaction-level and document-level tax. You do not need to be an expert in every utility market, but you are confident driving tax decisions and talking to regulations and compliance teams

  • Systems thinking across charging, issuance, cost calculation, ledger and ERP, reasoning about dependencies and edge cases rather than the happy path alone

  • A track record of turning regulatory and finance requirements into product without being prescriptive about the engineering implementation

  • Advanced AI fluency. You use AI hands-on to explore problems, stress-test decisions and move faster

  • Strong written communication, anchoring decisions in evidence and presenting options with tradeoffs

  • Fluency in English is required

  • Comfortable working across cultures, time zones and with regional teams

⭐️Bonus Points:

  • Experience with third-party tax integrations

  • Utilities or energy domain experience

  • Exposure to ERP or GL integration

  • Multi-market or international rollout experience

  • Accruals or cost accounting familiarity

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine

About Us

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

  • Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

  • Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

  • Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

  • Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

  • Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact.

  • Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics.

  • Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve.

  • Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance.

  • Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology.

  • Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter.

  • Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in search, discovery, ML, or NLP-heavy products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery.

  • Strong ML product depth — owning production models and reasoning about tradeoffs between high-capacity (LLM / batch) and low-latency (real-time) approaches — and a habit of staying current with state-of-the-art research.

  • Fluency with retrieval and recall, query understanding (tokenization, synonyms, spelling correction, multilingual support), and search evaluation frameworks.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every quality investment back to business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of quality and a shared set of business metrics, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and ML Ops.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

  • Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

  • Fully remote team — choose where you live.

  • Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • Parental leave for qualified employees.

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

Preferred qualifications

The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
  • Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
  • Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
  • Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.

  • Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
  • Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
  • Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
  • Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
  • You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
  • You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
  • Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
  • Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
  • Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
  • Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
  • Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
  • Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
  • Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

jobs.title: (Senior) Frontend Engineer - Visual Experiences
Senior Product Designer
Senior Frontend Engineer (Full-stack)
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead frontend work in one of our product teams: a TypeScript/Angular application with Storybook-driven components and Cypress e2e coverage, in front of a Java backend. You own the user experience end-to-end, from component architecture and state management down to the API shape, because the backend is yours to touch too. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship without waiting for hand-offs.

Frontend is your craft; full-stack is your reach. You'll spend most of your time in the frontend, and you can ship a backend endpoint when the feature needs it rather than filing a ticket and waiting. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side.

What You'll Do

  • Own complex, data-dense UIs: dashboards, monitoring views, large tables, diffs and drill-downs that stay fast and legible.
  • Drive component architecture, state management, and frontend performance.
  • Build with a component library and Storybook; keep the design system coherent as the product grows.
  • Write tests at every layer. You'll help keep our Cypress e2e suite meaningful.
  • Build the frontend of agentic features: interfaces where users direct, review, and act on LLM-powered workflows.
  • Improve our systems for agentic development on the frontend: conventions, Storybook coverage, and tests that agents can build against reliably.
  • Shape the APIs you consume, and implement backend changes (Java) when your feature needs them.
  • Mentor backend-focused engineers on frontend, helping the team grow more full-stack and deliver features end to end.
  • Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building frontend for real products: complex single-page applications with real users, not just marketing sites.
  • Expert TypeScript and deep experience with a modern framework: Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud); strong React/Vue engineers willing to work in Angular are welcome.
  • Frontend craft: component architecture, state management, rendering performance, responsive design, and an eye for detail (you can spot a misaligned pixel).
  • Testing as a habit: you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
  • Working backend skills: you can read and modify a Java service, design an API from the consumer's perspective, and write competent SQL.
  • Systems insight: you understand how an API's shape drives round-trips, data flow, and perceived latency in the UI.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Data-heavy or developer-tool products: data visualization, monitoring, analytics UIs.
  • Design-system or component-library ownership.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

The Role

We're hiring a Product Lead to own a product area at Kota. You'll set the vision and strategy, make the calls on what gets built, and lead the engineers who build it. Product Leads managing their own engineers is unusual and it's deliberate: one person accountable for the product and the team shipping it.


You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes.


That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set. As we add products and move into new countries the areas will change, so we want someone adaptable and opportunistic who'll own whichever part matters most as we grow. The remit is broad with little structure around it, so it suits a high ownership drive.


What You'll Do

  • Own the vision and strategy for your area, and make the product calls on what gets built

  • Lead and grow a group of product engineers, coaching them on scope and delivery decisions rather than assigning tickets

From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes.   • Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business

Build security culture and external credibility

  • Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences

jobs.description:
Company & Role Overview 

About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 

Role overview

As Post-Market Surveillance Manager, you'll build and run our global post-market surveillance system — from complaint handling and adverse-event reporting to data trending and governance — and lead its rollout across Customer Support, QA, Regulatory, Engineering, Clinical, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll turn post-market insights into action that improves product quality, patient safety, and the customer experience, drawing on strong judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to influence stakeholders globally. 

Requirements

Core responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run our global post-market surveillance system — complaint handling, adverse-event/vigilance reporting, escalation, and governance — staying hands-on for complex or high-risk cases
  • Own the complaint-to-report pipeline: reportability assessments and timely, accurate adverse-event/vigilance submissions across markets (US, EU, and others)
  • Build the KPIs, dashboards, and trending methods that surface safety, quality, and customer-experience signals — and turn findings into action via CAPA, risk management, product/software fixes, and labeling updates
  • Lead the cross-functional rollout — implementation plans, priorities, dependencies, and risk — to build sustainable post-market processes and infrastructure
  • Present post-market performance and recommendations to leadership, and support PMS reports, PSURs, and management reviews 
  • Act as SME during audits and inspections, and guide internal teams and external partners on post-market activities 

Background & Experience

  • 7+ years in medical-device post-market surveillance, complaint handling, quality, or regulatory affairs, including leading process implementations 
  • At least a bachelor's degree
  • Hands-on experience with complaint investigations, reportability assessments, and regulatory submissions (FDA MDR, EU MDR vigilance/PMS, ISO 13485, ISO 14971), plus post-market data analysis
  • Program management skills — workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies — plus an analytical mindset for turning complaint data into risk-based recommendations 
  • Strong communicator, comfortable influencing cross-functional teams, leadership, and regulators
  • Hands-on, independent leadership style; able to scale processes as we grow
  • Nice to have: experience with additional international markets or digital complaint-management systems

What success looks like

  • Scalable processes for complaint intake, investigation, and resolution — with clear escalation pathways to ensure adverse events and reportable incidents are identified, assessed, and reported within regulatory timeline
  • Customer Support consistently identifies, documents, and escalates complaints and potential safety events, thanks to close partnership and training
  • KPIs and dashboards give clear visibility into complaint timeliness, resolution, regulatory reporting, and emerging trends
  • Post-market insights translate into action — product improvements, CAPAs, risk-management updates, and a better customer experience

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to commercial success from start to end 

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location)

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

jobs.description:
Votre Rôle

Au sein de l'équipe B2B France, vous contribuez au développement et à l’engagement de notre réseau de professionnels de santé en construisant et pilotant des activations B2B adaptées aux besoins du marché français.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Regional Managers afin d’identifier les besoins du terrain, de les transformer en initiatives pertinentes et, lorsque cela est possible, de les déployer à l’échelle du réseau.

  • Construire et piloter le plan d’activation B2B en définissant un calendrier annuel de campagnes, programmes et initiatives destinés aux professionnels de santé, en lien avec les priorités business

  • Concevoir les parcours partenaires en développant les parcours d’onboarding, d’engagement, de développement et de réactivation adaptés aux différents profils et niveaux de maturité des professionnels

  • Développer des programmes d’engagement et de développement du réseau, notamment autour de campagnes thématiques, lancements produits, réactivation, challenges, formations ou initiatives saisonnières

  • Piloter le déploiement des programmes en collaboration avec les Regional Managers vous déployez les initiatives auprès des partenaires, recueillez leurs retours et adaptez les dispositifs aux besoins du terrain

  • Développer l’activation CRM B2B en segmentant la base de professionnels et en mettant en place des communications et scénarios permettant d’accompagner les partenaires tout au long de leur parcours

  • Mesurer la performance des activations et identifier les opportunités d’amélioration, afin d’optimiser continuellement l’engagement du réseau et leur contribution au développement du marché français

Votre Profil

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation avec orientation scientifique (nutrition, biologie, santé ou domaine similaire) et vous disposez d’une première expérience en marketing ou gestion de projet

  • Vous avez une réelle capacité à comprendre, synthétiser et vulgariser des informations scientifiques et à les transformer en contenus clairs, pédagogiques et pertinents pour des professionnels de santé

  • Vous êtes organisé(e), autonome et capable de piloter plusieurs projets simultanément, tout en coordonnant différentes parties prenantes

  • Vous avez une approche à la fois analytique et orientée business : vous savez identifier les priorités, mesurer les résultats et transformer les apprentissages en actions concrètes

  • Vous aimez travailler de manière transverse et savez transformer des besoins provenant du terrain en solutions structurées et scalables

  • Vous parlez couramment français et anglais (à l'écrit comme à l'oral)

À noter : L'anglais étant notre langue d'entreprise, la communication avec le siège ainsi que les premiers entretiens se dérouleront en anglais

Ce que nous offrons

  • Une réduction attractive sur l'ensemble de nos produits - des huiles essentielles aux vitamines et nutriments.

  • 25 jours de congés payés par an, complétés par jusqu'à 5 jours de repos offerts entre Noël et le Nouvel An.

  • Parce que les plus belles réussites naissent des rencontres, nous adoptons un modèle hybride avec un jour de télétravail par semaine (jusqu'à deux selon votre département) et la possibilité de travailler jusqu'à deux semaines par an depuis l'étranger.

  • Une réelle autonomie, un terrain propice aux initiatives, ainsi que l'opportunité d'apporter votre expertise et de concrétiser vos meilleures idées.

  • Des espaces de travail accueillants avec un accès privilégié à une large sélection de thés biologiques et de superfoods du monde entier.

  • Nous aimons célébrer nos succès ensemble ! Événements réguliers, tea parties, fêtes de Noël et d'été, ainsi que diverses activations influenceurs (comme pour la Journée internationale des droits des femmes).

Postulez en envoyant votre CV et votre lettre de motivation - idéalement en anglais.

B2B Marketing Activation Manager (all genders) - France (Paris)

Your role

As part of the French B2B team, you will contribute to the development and engagement of our healthcare professional network by building and managing B2B activations tailored to the needs of the French market.

You will work closely with the Regional Managers to identify needs from the field, turn them into relevant initiatives and, whenever possible, deploy them across the wider network.

  • Build and lead the B2B activation plan by defining an annual calendar of campaigns, programs and initiatives targeting healthcare professionals, aligned with business priorities

  • Design partner journeys by developing onboarding, engagement, development and reactivation journeys tailored to the different profiles and levels of maturity of our healthcare professionals

  • Develop network engagement and development programs, including thematic campaigns, product launches, reactivation initiatives, challenges, trainings and seasonal initiatives

  • Lead program deployment by working closely with Regional Managers to roll out initiatives to partners, gather feedback and adapt programs to field needs

  • Develop B2B CRM activation by segmenting the healthcare professional database and implementing communications and journeys that support partners throughout their relationship with Sunday Natural

  • Measure activation performance and identify opportunities for improvement to continuously optimize network engagement and their contribution to the development of the French market

Your profile

  • You have a scientific background or degree in nutrition, biology, healthcare or a similar field and you have initial experience in marketing or project management

  • You have a strong ability to understand, synthesize and communicate scientific information in an accessible way, and transform it into clear, educational and relevant content for healthcare professionals

  • You are organized, autonomous and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while coordinating different stakeholders

  • You have both an analytical and business-oriented mindset: you know how to identify priorities, measure results and turn learnings into concrete actions

  • You enjoy working cross-functionally and are able to turn field needs into structured and scalable solutions

  • Fluency in French and English (written and spoken)

Please note: As English is our company language, internal communication and initial interviews will take place in English.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 25 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, this role requires you to be based in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

It would be even better if you have:

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. You are the architect and builder of the customer-facing side of the LEASETEQ platform in Berlin, and the owner of our German market on it. You work in a small, senior team where your decisions have direct product impact, and you naturally bring AI tooling into your daily engineering workflow without being asked.

What you will do

  • Own the German market on our customer-facing platform: credit and compliance requirements, dealer flows, German copy, and the acceptance criteria that make them verifiable
  • Design and build the digital application journey — multi-step forms, validation, resumable state, document upload, KYC steps and the unhappy paths users actually hit
  • Build and maintain the customer, dealer and operations portals, including the operations board and the logic that decides where a case belongs
  • Write the use-case and API layers behind the journey to our clean-architecture standard — this is a full-stack role, not a UI role
  • Own field-level mapping into the CRM and the Flowable-based process engine — beneficial ownership, source of funds, origin of income, additional persons — where a wrong key is a compliance defect, not a cosmetic one
  • Author specification-driven change proposals, and act as the named human approver for journey and mapping changes in the German market
  • Grow end-to-end test coverage on the critical journeys: coverage is what licenses autonomous agent work in a module
  • Work with our Berlin backend team on the seam between the orchestration core and the customer-facing platform, and with our Jakarta platform engineers who own the journey across all three markets
  • Communicate clearly in German and English with engineering peers and business stakeholders


Your profile

  • 6+ years of full-stack TypeScript engineering, with recent production work in React and Next.js App Router — server components, server actions and route handlers, with a clear grasp of what runs where — is mandatory
  • Fintech experience is mandatory: production work on a regulated financial product — leasing, lending, banking, payments or insurance — where money moved and a regulator could ask why
  • Proven ownership of a complex multi-step onboarding or application flow is mandatory: validation strategy, partial persistence and resumption, conditional branching by market or product, document upload
  • Real backend capability: use cases, repository implementations, API handlers and PostgreSQL / Prisma queries — roughly a 60/40 split toward the frontend, not 90/10

  • Working understanding of the German regulatory environment for consumer credit or asset finance — BaFin-supervised context, AML/KYC obligations, consumer-credit disclosure — is a strong plus
  • Internationalisation as a habit — no hard-coded strings, and awareness of what four locales do to layout and copy
  • Fluent German and English


Why us?

  • Founding-team-level ownership of our customer-facing platform and of the German market on it
  • Direct collaboration with the CTO and the founders, including regular visits to our Swiss headquarters
  • A genuinely AI-first process, not a slogan: specification-driven delivery where agents execute approved changes and humans own scope, architecture, regulatory and release decisions
  • Hybrid setup with 2-3 days per week in our coworking office in Berlin (WeWork, Stresemannstrasse)
  • Competitive and fair salary: €70,000 - €90,000 gross per year, depending on experience and impact
  • 10–15% annual bonus tied to company performance and clear OKRs
  • Tax-free monthly benefit allowance of €50 that you can use for what you personally value
