jobs.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali.

Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels.

Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne). 

Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.

 

Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.

 

Vos missions principales :

  • Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides.

  • Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge.

  • Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle.

  • Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.

 

Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un :

  • Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche.

Profil scientifique recherché :

  • Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques.

  • Appétence pour le domaine de la santé.

Compétences attendues :

  • Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité.

  • Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets.

  • Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude.

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international.

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

  • Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle.

  • Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java).

  • Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads and software on standardized satellites, and we are building the first marketplace for space-based AI applications: the store where partners publish, deploy, and monetize AI solutions that run on satellites in orbit. We are hiring the founding developer of that marketplace. You will work directly with the Director of Marketplace to take the platform from MVP to the system behind dozens of partner solutions, on a small team where you own features end-to-end and ship weekly.

About this role:
  • Build the Marketplace storefront, partner portal, and admin tooling.
  • Design and implement the APIs and services behind them: catalog, onboarding, entitlements, and metering.
  • Integrate with our mission platform for authentication, workflow triggers, and solution deployment in close collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Build connectors for third-party constellations and data providers.
  • Own quality: tests, CI/CD, monitoring.

Must Haves:
  • 4+ years building and shipping full-stack products.
  • Experience with Sprint development.
  • Strong TypeScript/React on the front end and solid backend experience in Python, Go, or Node.
  • Cloud-native by default (we run on GCP): containers/kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure as code.
  • Comfortable with API design, OAuth, and multi-tenant authorization.
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development workflows and expected to use them.
  • You have shipped a zero-to-one product, ideally a marketplace, developer platform, or SaaS portal, and you like small teams with large scope.

Nice to Haves:
  • Billing integrations (Stripe or similar).
  • Geospatial or earth observation exposure.
  • Security-minded engineering (tenant isolation, audit trails).
  • Experience in the architecture of modern systems.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Development- Europe
jobs.description:
We are growing! We are currently looking to hire an experienced Senior Manager, Customer Development for our Paris office.  

Reporting directly to the Chief Customer Officer, you will lead selected business development priorities and support the broader Customer Development team in accelerating CXG's growth across Europe. 

Who we are 

Founded in 2006, we are a global business with a presence in 12 offices across four continents, serving over 200 luxury clients with a team of 250 professionals.  

At CXG, we are passionate about evolving, elevating, and transforming experiences to bring brand promises to life. We offer strategic solutions that impact performance and elevate the customer and employee experience for some of the world's most iconic premium and luxury brands.

What you will be doing 

Your primary mandate will be to open and develop high-value opportunities within specific priority verticals, named accounts, and strategic growth initiatives defined by the Chief Customer Officer. You will bring a strong hunter mindset and an established network within the luxury and premium ecosystem, while working closely with the existing Customer Development team to strengthen our pipeline, respond to strategic opportunities, and position CXG as a long-term partner.  

Your daily tasks will involve: 

  • Translating the strategic growth priorities defined by the Chief Customer Officer into focused business development plans for selected verticals, markets, and target accounts. 
  • Leveraging your established network and market credibility to secure access to senior decision-makers and create new opportunities with high-potential luxury and premium brands. 
  • Building and maintaining a qualified new-business pipeline, with a strong focus on originating new relationships, opening doors, and converting priority prospects into clients. 
  • Supporting the wider Customer Development team on strategic pursuits, including account research, opportunity qualification, pitch preparation, and coordinated responses to requests for proposal and competitive tenders. 
  • Leading the full commercial cycle for assigned opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through proposal development, tender response, negotiation, and closing. 
  • Designing compelling, insight-driven and commercially sound proposals that articulate CXG's differentiated value, with appropriate pricing, margin, scope, and contractual alignment. 
  • Promoting a cross-practice approach and actively supporting the go-to-market of CXG’s new solutions by connecting client needs to our expertise across Measurement, Academy, Customer Insights, and Consulting, and translating them into integrated, multi-practice commercial opportunities. 
  • Working closely with market Customer Success, regional leaders, Operations, and Practice Leads to build integrated solutions that are relevant, feasible, and impactful. 
  • Ensuring structured handovers to Customer Success and remaining involved during the early stages of the client relationship to protect commercial commitments, revenue, and client trust. 
  • Representing CXG in relevant industry events and senior client environments, while sharing market intelligence, relationships, and best practices with the Customer Development team. 

Requirements

What you will bring along 

This role is designed for an experienced business developer who combines a strong hunter mentality, an active senior-level network, and the ability to collaborate effectively on complex opportunities. You should also bring: 

  • A Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. 
  • At least 8 years of experience in business development, strategic sales, account development, or consulting, ideally within an international environment. 
  • Deep knowledge of the luxury, retail, or premium services ecosystem, supported by an established and demonstrable network of senior decision-makers. 
  • A proven track record of originating opportunities, winning new logos, and closing high-value, multi-stakeholder deals. 
  • Strong experience preparing and leading complex proposals, requests for proposal, and competitive tender responses in a consultative or multi-solution environment. 
  • The credibility and influencing skills required to engage C-level, regional, and operational stakeholders. 
  • Strong negotiation and commercial judgment, including the ability to manage pricing, margin, scope, and contractual discussions. 
  • Excellent presentation, storytelling, and written communication skills. 
  • A high level of ownership, autonomy, resilience, and accountability, combined with a collaborative mindset and the ability to contribute to shared team priorities. 
  • Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are a strong advantage.

jobs.title: Director of Creative (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du siehst eine Brand und weißt sofort, was ihr fehlt.

Du erkennst, ob ein Design außergewöhnlich oder einfach nur schön ist. Du verstehst, warum Content Reichweite bekommt, warum ein Creative verkauft und warum sich eine Website trotz perfekter Optik nicht richtig anfühlt.

Du kennst die Trends von morgen, ohne jedem Trend hinterherzulaufen.

Und du kannst aus all dem eine klare kreative Richtung entwickeln, der starke Teams folgen können.

Genau diese Person suchen wir.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen und wurde von der Financial Times & Statista ausgezeichnet. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, aus Pammys eine globale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Performance und schnelles Wachstum haben uns groß gemacht.

Jetzt wollen wir Pammys auch kreativ auf das nächste Level bringen.

Dafür suchen wir einen Director of Creative (m/w/d), der die kreative Gesamtverantwortung für Pammys übernimmt.

Wichtig: Wir sind eine Office-first Company. Diese Rolle sitzt in Hamburg und arbeitet eng mit unseren Creative Teams, Marketing und der Geschäftsführung zusammen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der gesamten Creative Strategy und Creative Direction von Pammys über Brand, Social Media, Paid Social, Content, Graphic Design und UX/UI hinweg
  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung unserer Heads of Social Media, Content Production und UX/UI sowie Weiterentwicklung der gesamten Creative Organisation
  • Aufbau einer unverwechselbaren visuellen Markenwelt und Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Brand Identity über alle relevanten Customer Touchpoints
  • Verantwortung für die Creative Strategy unserer Paid-Social-Kanäle und enge Verzahnung von Brand, Organic Social, Performance Marketing, Media Buying und CRO
  • Entwicklung von quartalsweisen und saisonalen Kampagnen, Creative Concepts und Content-Roadmaps gemeinsam mit den verantwortlichen Teams
  • Steuerung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Creative Output, Qualität und Geschwindigkeit über alle Creative Teams hinweg
  • Übersetzung aktueller Social-, Design-, Fashion-, Content- und Cultural Trends sowie Customer und Market Insights in relevante Konzepte für Pammys
  • Verantwortung für Budget, Ressourcenplanung, Priorisierung und Hiring innerhalb der Creative Organisation
  • Nutzung von Performance-Daten, Creative Analytics und Customer Insights, um kreative Entscheidungen zu treffen und erfolgreiche Ansätze konsequent weiterzuentwickeln
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Brand, Performance Marketing und Produktentwicklung bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von Pammys


Dein Profil

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Creative Director, Director of Creative, Head of Creative oder in einer vergleichbaren Creative-Leadership-Rolle, idealerweise in DTC, E-Commerce, Fashion oder einer schnell wachsenden Consumer Brand
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung von Führungskräften und multidisziplinären Creative Teams
  • Herausragendes Verständnis von Graphic Design, Art Direction, Brand Design und visuellen Systemen
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von UX/UI, E-Commerce Customer Journeys und Conversion
  • Tiefes Know-how in Content Production, Social Media, Creator Content und modernen Plattformmechaniken
  • Starkes Verständnis von Paid Social, Creative Performance, Media Buying und CRO
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung großer Brand- und Performance-Kampagnen sowie im Aufbau skalierbarer Creative-Prozesse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit KPIs, Creative Analytics und Performance-Daten
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis sowie Erfahrung mit Budgets, Ressourcenplanung und Priorisierung
  • Außergewöhnliches Gespür für Design, Fashion, Popkultur, Social Media und digitales Konsumentenverhalten
  • Eine klare Meinung, hohe Entscheidungsstärke und die Fähigkeit, starken Persönlichkeiten Orientierung zu geben
  • Extrem schnelle Auffassungsgabe und echte Neugier auf AI, neue Technologien, Plattformen und kreative Entwicklungen
  • Hoher Qualitätsanspruch kombiniert mit Geschwindigkeit, Pragmatismus und Execution Power


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Creative Ownership: Du verantwortest die kreative Entwicklung der gesamten Marke
  • Leadership: Du führst mehrere zentrale Creative Bereiche und ihre Heads
  • Impact: Deine Entscheidungen werden über Millionen von Customer Touchpoints sichtbar
  • Scale: Über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden und eine Brand mitten in der internationalen Expansion
  • Speed: Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Resources: Bestehende Teams aus Social Media, Content Production und UX/UI, die du gemeinsam mit uns auf das nächste Level entwickelst
  • Benefits: Attraktive Vergütung, Deutschlandticket-Zuschuss und Corporate Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Buchhalter IFRS & HGB (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest deine Erfahrung im Accounting und in der Bilanzbuchhaltung in eine dynamische Unternehmensgruppe mit Sitz in Hamburg einbringen, mehrere Gesellschaften eigenverantwortlich betreuen und Finance Prozesse aktiv weiterentwickeln?

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Unser Kunde ist eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe, die spezialisierte Softwareunternehmen für den öffentlichen Sektor unter einem Dach vereint. Der Fokus liegt auf zukunftsrelevanten Bereichen wie Mobilität, Energie und öffentlicher Sicherheit.

Aufgaben

Als Senior Accountant IFRS & HGB betreust du eigenverantwortlich zwei bis drei Softwaregesellschaften und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Finance Team für verlässliche Abschlüsse und skalierbare Accounting Prozesse.

  • Abschlussverantwortung: Erstellung von Monats, Quartals und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und IFRS für mehrere Gesellschaften.
  • Accounting: Steuerung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung von Hauptbuch und Anlagen bis hin zu Debitoren, Kreditoren und Kontenabstimmungen.
  • Software Bilanzierung: Abbildung spezifischer Geschäftsvorfälle rund um Softwarelizenzen, SaaS Modelle, Projektgeschäft sowie Wartungs und Supportverträge.
  • Steuern & Internationales: Erstellung von Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen sowie Bearbeitung grenzüberschreitender Sachverhalte und Unterstützung bei Jahressteuererklärungen.
  • Intercompany: Abstimmung und Verrechnung von Geschäftsvorfällen innerhalb der internationalen Unternehmensgruppe.
  • Systeme & Digitalisierung: Aktive Mitwirkung bei der Einführung von Odoo sowie bei der Automatisierung und Weiterentwicklung der Accounting Prozesse und Systemschnittstellen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Finance Teams und der Geschäftsführung sowie zentrale Ansprechperson für Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater, Banken und Betriebsprüfer.

Qualifikation

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Accounting, Rechnungswesen oder Steuern. Eine Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) ist von großem Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Mindestens 5 bis 10 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Accounting oder in der Bilanzbuchhaltung
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse nach HGB und IFRS.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Buchhaltungssoftware und gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und der Einführung neuer Systeme.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit, Genauigkeit und Hands on Mentalität sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie Motivation, sich fachlich und perspektivisch weiterzuentwickeln.

Nice to haves: Jedes zusätzliche Know how ist ein Pluspunkt

  • Erfahrung in einem Software-, IT- oder Technologieunternehmen
  • Erfahrung in der parallelen Betreuung mehrerer Gesellschaften oder Geschäftseinheiten
  • Kenntnisse im österreichischen UGB
  • Erfahrung aus Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Beratung, beispielsweise aus dem Big Four Umfeld

Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Freue dich auf ein attraktives Vergütungsmodell, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung kannst du zwei bis drei Tage pro Woche im Homeoffice arbeiten.
  • Modernes Office: Zentraler Arbeitsplatz in Hamburg mit moderner Ausstattung und sehr guter Anbindung.
  • Work Life Balance: Eine geregelte 40 Stunden Woche und 30 Urlaubstage schaffen einen verlässlichen Rahmen.
  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Durch das weitere Wachstum der Gruppe und den geplanten Aufbau gemeinsamer Finance Strukturen entstehen langfristig spannende Möglichkeiten, zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bringe deine Erfahrung aktiv beim Aufbau moderner Accounting Prozesse und bei der Implementierung neuer Systeme ein.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit dem Finance Führungsteam und den Finance Verantwortlichen der Portfoliounternehmen zusammen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Unterstützung bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.
  • Unternehmenskultur: Dich erwartet ein unternehmerisches Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.

Die Rolle als Senior Accountant IFRS & HGB klingt genau nach dir?
Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen Telefonat weitere Insights zu Unternehmen und Position.

jobs.title: Head of Technology (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
We find your position.

ISA Telematics baut Systeme, die Menschen, Fahrzeuge und Güter im Blick behalten, wenn es darauf ankommt: Notruf, Ortung, Alarmierung.

Das Besondere daran ist der Umfang. Die ganze Kette läuft durch eine Hand, von der Firmware auf dem Gerät über Funkprotokoll und Server bis zur Leitstelle. Kein Modul, kein Ausschnitt: das komplette System.

Und die Probleme sind echt. GPS, das im Stahlbau aussteigt. Mobilfunk, der abbricht, wenn er gebraucht wird. Geräte, die jahrelang im Feld stehen und trotzdem aktualisierbar bleiben müssen. Ein Alarm, der nicht meistens ankommt, sondern immer.

Unsere Kunden: Industrie, Energieversorger, Bahn und Logistik, Kliniken, Polizei- und Sicherheitsorganisationen im DACH-Raum. Das Produkt ist eingeführt, zertifiziert und profitabel, du baust also mit echten Nutzern und laufenden Umsätzen im Rücken.

Nach vorn ist viel Platz: weitere Branchen, neue Produkte auf der bestehenden Plattform, internationale Märkte, ein stärkeres App-Geschäft. Was zuerst gebaut wird, entscheidest du mit, gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Entwickler, der das System seit Jahren betreut.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

  • Volle Verantwortung für Produkt und Technik: Architektur, Roadmap, Code
  • Rund zwölf Monate übergibt dir der Entwickler das System persönlich, anschließend leitest du den Bereich Product & Technology
  • Du entscheidest, was bleibt, was modernisiert wird und was neu entsteht
  • Neue Produkte und Anwendungsfälle auf der bestehenden Plattform mitgestalten
  • Kundenprojekte von der Aufwandsschätzung bis zum Go-live, inklusive Geräte- und Ortungsanbindung (TCP/UDP, XML)
  • Normkonforme Weiterentwicklung (DGUV, DIN VDE V 0825, CE) und Störungsanalyse im laufenden Betrieb

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

  • Java: drei Jahre professionelle Entwicklung
  • SQL und relationale Datenbanken, Git im Alltag
  • Kommunikationsschnittstellen entwickeln und debuggen (TCP/UDP, XML)
  • Aufwände abschätzen und mit technischen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite verhandeln
  • Führungskompetenz und unternehmerisches Denken
  • Deutsch & Englisch verhandlungssicher

Benefits

Von Vorteil:

Android, JavaScript, Linux, Windows Server, Tomcat, Netzwerktechnik, GPS, Mobilfunk/M2M, Firmware, Informix, Erfahrung mit Produktnormen.

Was wir bieten

  • Viel Gestaltungs- und Entscheidungsspielraum in einem kleinen Team mit kurzen Wegen
  • Gehaltsspanne 70.000–90.000 € p. a. je nach Erfahrung
  • Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und leitest zukünftig den Bereich Product & Technology
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • Aufbauphase selbst gestalten: Produkt, Kunden und Cashflow sind da, die nächste Ausbaustufe baust du

Schick uns, woran du zuletzt gearbeitet hast und melde dich bei uns bei Interesse!

jobs.title: Working Student/Intern Sales & Business Development (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About ONIQ

ONIQ is building a new software category for the next generation of manufacturing operations. Our platform helps industrial companies understand what is happening across their production processes, uncover where efficiency is lost and act on the opportunities that matter most.

We bring together manufacturing expertise, advanced software and AI to help teams improve production at scale. The goal is to make production more efficient, more resilient and more sustainable, and to help teams make better decisions where they matter most.

We are a highly motivated team with a strong sense of ownership and passion for what we do. Our entrepreneurial mindset and commitment to innovation have enabled us to grow fast and help shape the future of manufacturing with cutting-edge software. At ONIQ, culture is just as important as product. We foster an environment rooted in authenticity, diversity, integrity, and mutual respect, where everyone is encouraged to bring their whole self to work.


What you will do

You will support the Sales and Growth teams across the entire sales cycle by generating data-driven insights, qualifying leads, maintaining CRM data quality, and contributing to go-to-market and sales execution activities. You will work closely together with other teams such as customer onboarding, customer success, and marketing. You will:

  • Analyze market trends, customer segments, and internal sales performance to generate actionable insights for Customer Portfolio and Sales Management
  • Support the qualification of leads through structured research and data-driven assessment
  • Maintain quality of customer and opportunity data within the CRM system, ensuring transparency across the sales pipeline
  • Contribute to our international go-to-market and market entry initiatives by supporting market analyses, competitive benchmarking, and rollout activities
  • Support the sales execution process by preparing commercial documents such as quotations, order confirmations, and standard contractual materials
  • Coordinate the preparation, documentation, and follow-up of customer meetings, sales reviews, and internal alignment workshops
  • Be part of the entire sales cycle from marketing to customer onboarding and actively support marketing and sales activities such as campaigns, events, and digital initiatives


What we expect from you

  • You are currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • Ideally, you have gained initial practical experience through internships or student roles, preferably in customer service, marketing or customer-facing functions
  • You are available for a six-month internship or a working student position. Shorter internships may be possible depending on your availability and experience.
  • You are highly organized, able to work independently, and demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and reliability

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.

At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact. 

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability.

What You'll Own:

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.
  • Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.
  • Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.
  • Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.
  • Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.
  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like:
  • Product, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.
  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.


What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.

  • AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.

  • Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).

  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.

  • Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany, working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

Success Metrics

  • Technical quality and reliability

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

jobs.description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.Ingénieur / Ingénieure principal/e en thermomécanique (H/F) — Paris/Grenoble

    À propos de Vinci

    Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

    C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

    Présentation du poste

    En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

    En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

    Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

    Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

    Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

    Responsabilités

    • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

    • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

    • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

    • Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

    • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

  • Soutenir l'équipe dans le suivi des validations budgétaires et le pilotage des dépenses de campagne, en signalant tout écart ou changement.

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).

The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.

Main missions include:

  • Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

  • Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

  • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

We are currently hiring for new segments:

  • It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built.

  • We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

  • At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.)

  • Full working proficiency in French

  • At least advanced level in English

  • An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence

  • Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market

  • A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations

  • Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty

  • A prior experience working with senior leadership

  • You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them

  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role, we are looking to hire within the E-F level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Du musst nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen. Wenn du denkst, dass du gut zu der Rolle passt und Lust hast, dich weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! ☀️

jobs.title: Project Planner
jobs.description:
Job title: Project Planner

Location: UK (Remote) or London office (Angel)

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom — a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat — but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.

XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.

THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

Our model combines a new age of 4D Scheduling with objective, real-time insights using Augmented Reality for quality and progress tracking.

As a Planner at XYZ Reality, you will be responsible for managing the planning and delivery of projects across multiple locations, working in collaboration with our engineering, production and sales teams to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

We're open to planners from a wide range of project-based industries — including Oil & Gas, Energy, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing — where complex, multi-disciplinary programme management is second nature. If you're an experienced planner who's curious about construction technology and excited by the opportunity to apply your skills in a new sector, we want to hear from you.

We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement — and you will have the opportunity to shape the future of our company whilst making a meaningful impact on the construction industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Lead external planning teams with proficiency in Primavera P6, Asta Powerproject and 4D integration.

• Integrate Project Programme(s) in accordance with client requirements into the 3D design, including the MEP programme (Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing) to sequence the build within the BIM model.

• Work with the Sales Team on client calls, demonstrating strong schedule and project knowledge.

• Project data analytics using Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps and Excel — with regular progress reporting at both customer and company level.

• Monitor productivity and completion deadlines, maintaining regular stakeholder interaction as a front-end, client-facing role.

• Provide technical and assurance support for Planning & Project Controls within the XYZ Project Team.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

• 2+ years of scheduling experience in a complex, multi-disciplinary project environment — construction, Oil & Gas, energy, infrastructure, or similar.

• Proficiency with Primavera P6 or equivalent enterprise scheduling tools.

• Degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a related technical discipline — or equivalent practical experience.

• Right to work in the UK without sponsorship.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

• Strong programme management skills — able to integrate schedules, sequences, and dependencies across multi-disciplinary project workstreams.

• Ability to analyse a project sequence, identify risks and coordination issues, and drive resolution — regardless of industry background.

• A relentless and dynamic approach to working with people, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive the best outcomes.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

3 years

In deiner Rolle entwickelst und optimierst du die Elektronik hinter diesen Systemen – von leistungsfähigen Stromversorgungen und Platinen bis hin zur Neukonzeption einzelner Komponenten unserer Signalgeneratoren. Role Summary

The Parallax Cloud team builds the communication fabric that lets vehicles, mobile apps, and cloud services exchange live state and commands securely and reliably.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and operate services and APIs that hide messaging, routing, and authorization complexity from product teams. This is hands-on platform work: you will solve distributed-systems problems, trace failures across the stack, and carry changes from design through production.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate cloud services and gRPC/Protobuf APIs that let product teams read vehicle state, subscribe to changes, and send commands.

  • Operate and tune NATS, our high-performance messaging system, including configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, performance validation, and capacity planning.

  • Own services end to end, from implementation through deployment and production operation, using Kubernetes, GitOps/Argo CD, and infrastructure as code.

  • Diagnose production behavior using metrics, traces, logs, dashboards, and alerts.

  • Design, operate, and tune service networking, load balancers, and L4/L7 traffic routing.

  • Develop and run end-to-end, integration, and load tests to catch functional and performance regressions before production.

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • At least 5 years of software engineering experience focused on distributed systems, high-scale backend services, or streaming and messaging platforms.

  • Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language and willingness to work primarily in Go, with occasional work in Java and TypeScript client SDKs.

  • Practical experience building and operating production services, including observability and troubleshooting.

  • Solid foundations in API design, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems with working knowledge of Kubernetes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes and owning service deployments; familiarity with GitOps/Argo CD and infrastructure as code.

  • Strong knowledge of HTTP/2, TCP, L4/L7 load balancing along with experience operating gRPC services in production is a major plus.

Parallax Cloud engineers collaborate closely with both product and cloud platform teams, creating a unique opportunity to shape how connected features are designed and how the underlying platform evolves. jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einem guten Produktkonzept und einem Produkt, das am Ende wirklich pünktlich, in der richtigen Qualität und zur richtigen Marge im Lager steht.

Du hast jahrelang mit chinesischen Fabriken gearbeitet, kennst Produktionsrealitäten vor Ort und weißt, dass sich manche Probleme nicht per E-Mail lösen lassen.

Wenn eine Produktion steht, Ware verspätet ist oder Qualität nicht stimmt, wartest du nicht auf das nächste Statusmeeting.

Du löst das Problem.

Und wenn dafür ein Flug nach China notwendig ist, sitzt du im Flugzeug.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende daran, aus Pammys eine internationale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Mit unserem Wachstum steigen die Anforderungen an Produktentwicklung, Sortiment, Geschwindigkeit und Supply Chain massiv.

Dafür suchen wir einen Director Product (m/w/d), der die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Produktorganisation übernimmt und unsere Bereiche Product Development, Merchandising und Footwear Design führt.

Du steuerst nicht nur Produkte.

Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Trends, Ideen und Forecasts erfolgreiche Produkte werden, die zur richtigen Zeit, in der richtigen Menge, zur richtigen Qualität und zu wirtschaftlich starken Konditionen verfügbar sind.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Gesamtverantwortung für die Bereiche Product Development, Merchandising und Footwear Design
  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung der jeweiligen Heads und Senior Specialists sowie Weiterentwicklung der gesamten Product Organisation
  • Steuerung des kompletten Produktprozesses von Trend und Idee über Design, Sourcing, Sampling, Kalkulation und Produktion bis zur finalen Ware
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines starken internationalen Lieferanten- und Fabriknetzwerks mit klarem Schwerpunkt China

  • Analyse von Abverkauf, Nachfrage, Markttrends, Wettbewerbern und Customer Insights zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung des Produktportfolios
  • Aufbau klarer Prozesse, KPIs und Verantwortlichkeiten entlang des gesamten Product Lifecycles

  • Frühzeitige Identifikation von Risiken und konsequentes Gegensteuern, bevor aus kleinen Problemen große werden


Dein Profil

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in einer führenden Rolle im Bereich Product, Product Development, Sourcing oder Footwear, idealerweise in einer stark wachsenden Consumer-, Fashion- oder Footwear Brand
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von Führungskräften und multidisziplinären Product Teams
  • Tiefgreifende China-Erfahrung und belastbares Netzwerk zu Fabriken, Produzenten und Lieferanten
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse chinesischer Produktionsprozesse, Mentalitäten, Verhandlungsstrukturen und Lieferantenbeziehungen
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Sourcing, Sampling, Quality Control, Costing, Produktionsplanung und Supplier Management
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Footwear Development, Materialien, Konstruktion, Passform und Qualitätsanforderungen
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Marge, Einkaufspreise, MOQ, Volumen und Produktprofitabilität
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer Produkt- und Produktionsprozesse in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Sehr hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft, insbesondere nach China
  • Du bist bereit, auch kurzfristig zu reisen, wenn ein kritisches Produktions- oder Lieferproblem vor Ort gelöst werden muss
  • Ausgeprägte Entscheidungsstärke, hohe Belastbarkeit und echte Hands-on-Mentalität
  • Du wartest nicht auf perfekte Informationen, sondern kannst unter Zeitdruck fundierte Entscheidungen treffen
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung bis zum Ergebnis und akzeptierst kein „geht nicht“, bevor wirklich alle Optionen geprüft wurden

  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere für die Zusammenarbeit mit asiatischen Lieferanten relevante Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Gesamtverantwortung: Du führst einen der zentralsten Bereiche unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase

We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About Our Technology

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

The Role

At Black Semiconductor, logistics is more than moving materials from A to B. It is the infrastructure that keeps our operations running as we move towards production, it is becoming increasingly business-critical.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to take ownership of this function and help build it for our next stage of growth. This is a role for someone who enjoys both getting things done and building them up properly: you will participate in day-to-day operations, while at the same time developing the processes, structures and supply chain setup we need for the future.

Today, our logistics setup is very lean, giving you significant ownership from day one. With the setup and scaling of our main headquarters and new facility (FabONE), you will play a key role in scaling Black Semiconductor’s our operational capabilities as the company moves into production. You will work closely with our core business units to develop a reliable supply chain and strengthen compliance.

To Join Our Team, You Should Be Excited To:

  • Build and lead the logistics team and warehouse operations, providing both functional and disciplinary leadership.

  • To keep products moving, ensure reliable day-to-day logistics operations across domestic and international transportation, shipping and distribution, taking a hands-on approach where needed.

  • Develop and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes across warehousing, receiving, inventory, transportation, shipping and production support.

  • Drive initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, cost performance and delivery reliability, like our SAP S/4HANA rollout, establishing RASIC and best practices to building the team and capabilities needed for future growth.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across production, engineering, procurement and other business functions to ensure a reliable flow of materials and information.

  • Own dangerous goods handling and regulatory compliance, ensuring adherence to ADR, IATA, IMDG, and all relevant legal requirements

  • Ensure that compliance is an integral part of our logistics and supply chain processes right from the start.

Your Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in logistics, supply chain or warehouse management, import/export or manufacturing operations

  • At least 4 years of disciplinary leadership and people management experience, ideally with responsibility for teams with 5+ employees

  • Experience in a startup/scale-up environment or complex corporate organization, ideally in semiconductor, pharmaceutical or another highly regulated industry

  • Deep expertise in supply chain management, material flow, inventory management, production support and import/export regulations

  • Strong hands-on experience with WMS and ERP systems (SAP/S/4HANA experience is a plus)

  • Proven expertise in dangerous goods, German regulatory requirements and compliance, ideally combined with cleanroom logistics experience

  • A pragmatic leadership mindset, strategic thinking, and strong problem-solving as well as stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent German language skills (minimum: C1) and good English (minimum: B2)

What Makes This Role Different

Rather than maintaining existing playbooks, this is your chance to build a modern logistics function from the ground up. You will have the opportunity to shape the function from an early stage and define how logistics and supply chains should work at Black Semiconductor.

Your decisions will have a direct impact on our ability to operate, produce and scale. You will have the freedom to bring your expertise, challenge existing ways of working and build the team, processes and standards you believe are needed.

If you enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, taking ownership and building something that will grow with the company, this is an opportunity to make a real difference.

Our Work Culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters.

Let's Grow Together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development.

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority — in the present and future.

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward.

We connect chips — and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

The department Knowledge Technologies for Social Sciences (KTS) conducts research at the intersection of information retrieval, natural language processing, semantic technologies and human information interaction as foundation for innovative web portals and platforms for the search and use of research data.

  • Managing and coordinating the HaFER project to make it a success

DESCRIPTIF DU POSTE

Management & Leadership :

  • Encadrer, animer et faire grandir une équipe de développeurs Fullstack (suivi régulier, 1-to-1, mentoring, évolution de carrière).
  • Organiser et fluidifier le travail de l'équipe (découpage des tâches, chiffrage, priorisation) en collaboration avec le Product Owner.
  • Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement et garantir la qualité du code via des code reviews.
  • Organiser et fluidifier le travail de l'équipe : découpage des tâches, chiffrage, priorisation et planification des jalons de livraison.
  • Garantir la tenue des délais et la qualité des livrables, anticiper les risques (techniques ou de planning) et proposer des plans de mitigation.

Architecture & Développement (Hands-on) :
