  • Implémenter la logique complexe des opérations (règles de jeu, gains, validations) et gérer les problématiques de haute volumétrie.
  • Porter la vision technique de l'équipe : choix d'architecture, structuration des projets, définition des spécifications techniques.
  • Assurer la mise en production et le suivi post-production (stabilité, monitoring, alertes, gestion des incidents).

ENVIRONNEMENT & ENJEUX TECHNIQUES

  • Back-end : Node.js (TypeScript non transpilé avec JSDoc).
  • Écosystème Fullstack : capacité à interagir et guider l'équipe sur les enjeux Front-end (React/Vue, animation, intégration web) liés aux mini-jeux.
  • Événementiel : Kafka (consumer groups, reprocessing, gestion des erreurs).

  • Performance temps réel : faible latence, fort débit, observabilité (logs, métriques).
  • Concurrence & fiabilité : idempotence, gestion des retries, race conditions.
  • Données : MySQL (modélisation, transactions, optimisation des requêtes). Redis / Valkey (cache-aside, cohérence cache / DB, réduction de latence).
  • Architecture : Hexagonale (ports & adapters), forte exigence de testabilité et maintenabilité.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Issu d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'un master en informatique et fort d'une solide expérience en développement logiciel, particulièrement en Back-End (Node.js) avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux Front-End, tu justifies d'une expérience réussie en tant que Tech Lead, Lead Développeur ou Engineering Manager. 

Animé par la volonté de faire grandir tes équipes, tu disposes de la prise de hauteur nécessaire pour prendre des décisions techniques structurantes et concevoir des architectures robustes. 

Très à l'aise avec les systèmes distribués, la forte charge et les problématiques de scalabilité, tu portes un intérêt prononcé au clean code et à la construction de systèmes ultra-fiables en production. Enfin, autonome, pragmatique et doté d'un excellent relationnel, tu t'épanouiras pleinement dans un environnement où tes livraisons auront un impact direct.

Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Communications Lead to define how Orbital Industries is understood in the market - and to build the communications motion that makes that understanding stick.

This is a category-creation brief. You'll articulate what the AI Industrial is, why CurieOS matters, and how Orbital Industries' full-lifecycle approach (materials, engineering, hardware) represents something genuinely new. You'll translate deep technical work - across AI, materials science, and hardware engineering - into clear, distinctive, high-quality communication that builds authority with investors, technical buyers, talent, and the broader market.

Your job is to set the strategic direction: brand voice, messaging frameworks, content strategy, and open doors for media.

Key Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Brand Voice

  • Define and own Orbital Industries' external communications strategy — how we are positioned, perceived, and understood in the market

  • Build and enforce consistency in brand voice across all external channels: website, social, events, collateral, press

  • Set the messaging framework for CurieOS and its three pillars (Materials, Deployment, Hardware), ensuring our full-lifecycle positioning is sharp and differentiated

  • Write strong creative and messaging briefs for design, video, and campaign work — giving the GTM team clear strategic direction to execute against

  • Ensure a clean separation between Orbital Industries (brand authority, category definition) and Orbital IT (commercial, customer-facing) in how we communicate externally

Stakeholder messaging

  • Work closely with the CFO and founders to ensure investor messaging reflects Orbital Industries' positioning as the AI Industrial category leader, not just a product company

  • Translate technical milestones (CurieOS releases, customer deployments, materials breakthroughs) into compelling narratives

Content and copy

  • Own long-form writing, thought leadership, website messaging, investor content, and campaign assets - from strategy through to production

  • Produce content that makes Orbital Industries' work in AI, materials science and hardware engineering accessible without losing credibility or nuance — you know the difference between simplifying and dumbing down

  • Develop and maintain CurieOS content across its three pillars: materials discovery, deployment engineering, and hardware product development

  • Use LLMs and modern tools to work efficiently while maintaining high editorial standards

Social Media Strategy

  • Own organic social strategy: voice, editorial calendar, content direction and output quality

  • Build Orbital Industries' social presence into a distinctive point of view, not just a broadcast channel — the GTM team handles day-to-day posting and scheduling

  • Track developments across AI infrastructure and adjacent industries to keep content timely and credible

  • Partner with the GTM Lead to align organic and paid social messaging

Website messaging

  • Own website copy and landing-page messaging, ensuring it is sharp, current and aligned to business priorities

  • Work closely with the GTM team on copy for campaign landing pages — you own the message, they own the conversion optimisation and testing cycle

Press and Media

jobs.title: Group Tax Manager - 4 Month Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Tax Team 👋

Trainline is a FTSE 250 global travel tech business, and our Tax team plays a central role in how we manage our financial responsibilities across the Group. Since our Group Head of Tax joined, we have been on an exciting journey - building out a dynamic in-house tax function and transitioning from a fully outsourced model to a proactive, value-adding internal advisory and compliance capability. With a clear roadmap in place and an enthusiastic Senior Tax Analyst already embedded in the team, this is a genuinely compelling moment to join and help shape the next chapter of what our tax function can be.

As Interim Group Tax Manager, you will report directly to the Group Head of Tax and take real ownership across the full breadth of our tax obligations - spanning corporation tax, VAT, employment taxes, and transfer pricing across our UK and European entities. You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, HR Operations, Legal, and Treasury, acting as a key bridge between the tax function and the wider business, whilst also playing an active role in supporting the professional development of the Senior Tax Analyst and managing relationships with external advisors and auditors.

In this role as the Interim Group Tax Manager, you will...🚄

  • Own the management of all compliance tax matters across the Group's UK and European entities (UK, France, Italy, Spain, and Belgium), including corporation tax, VAT, and employment taxes, working with external advisors to ensure accurate and timely submissions across all jurisdictions.

  • Lead the tax accounting function end-to-end, including preparation of tax disclosures in statutory accounts, management of Group audit provision corporation tax calculations, and ownership of tax journals and postings using Microsoft D365 - acting as the bridge between tax and finance.

  • Drive the budgeting and forecasting of corporation taxes, leveraging forecasting software (Pigment) and automating calculations where possible, whilst managing Quarterly Instalment Payments and cash tax positions in collaboration with the Finance and Treasury teams.

  • Review and manage UK and EU VAT return submissions via Making Tax Digital software, and oversee Operational Transfer Pricing across Group entities, ensuring intercompany agreements are maintained and invoicing is operating as expected.

  • Lead the management of R&D tax relief claims across Group jurisdictions, working closely with technical teams and external advisors to ensure submissions are accurate and timely.

  • Champion tax process improvement across the business, identifying automation opportunities, communicating best practices, and delivering training to the wider team to embed lasting change.

  • Manage tax governance for the Group, including the CCO risk register, the SAO annual process, tax accounting controls, and process documentation, ensuring a well-governed and audit-ready function.

  • Support the Group Head of Tax on ad-hoc research and project work - including monitoring VAT issues, transfer pricing developments, and the tax treatment of new product offerings - whilst also actively supporting the Senior Tax Analyst's development in the profession.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • A professional tax or accounting qualification such as ACA, CTA, ACCA, or equivalent, with significant experience in a broad tax role gained in practice, in-house, or a combination of both.

  • Proven experience preparing UK corporation tax returns and audit provisions at Group level, paired with a strong working knowledge of tax accounting principles.

  • Experience managing compliance obligations across multiple jurisdictions and a range of taxes, including corporation tax, VAT, and employment taxes.

  • Strong analytical ability and high proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the capability to build and review complex financial models and tax calculations with a high level of accuracy.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to translate complex tax matters into clear, accessible language for non-specialist stakeholders across the business.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines effectively, and collaborate across teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.

  • Experience supporting or mentoring colleagues within a tax or finance team, with a genuine interest in contributing to others' professional growth.

  • Ideally, some exposure to tax forecasting or automation tools; familiarity with Microsoft D365 or a similar ERP system would also be helpful, though not essential.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!
